summary: Naturalisation status lists (GloNAF, GRIIS), occurrence data (GBIF) and generic matrix-population databases (COMPADRE/COMADRE) are open, but no fetched dataset pairs fecundity and survival of the same species in native and introduced ranges at scale.
next_step: Compile native-vs-introduced vital-rate pairs from the Colautti/Parker meta-analysis supplements and COMPADRE/COMADRE entries tagged as invasive, then pair with GloNAF/GRIIS status for the spread outcome.
obstacles_confirmed: Native-range and introduced-range demographic pairs were not found in any queried repository (two Dryad searches returned zero hits).
GloNAF covers plants only; animals need GRIIS or occurrence data.
Zenodo API blocked (HTTP 403) during this scout, so Zenodo-hosted files were not listed.
